evidence: Touches contrib/guix and ci/lint/requirements.txt under the Build system label to update the Guix time-machine commit.
rationale: Fixes native Guix builds on RISC-V hosts by bumping the Guix time-machine and working around upstream test failures in python-lief dependencies on riscv64. While valuable for architecture support, native RISC-V Guix building is not a tier-1 release platform, making this change reasonably deferrable.
